limits: The full1885-test suite is current-stage only; reuse requires identical code/tests/fixtures/embedded Core and Game data plus Core DLL and exact same-stage TRX.

Per-original scoped cancellation physically arrives at a known fixed recipient post and becomes effective at max(receipt,requested time). Initial loss remains immutable. Original/copy/held original are suppressed or one current scoped movement is stopped, without reviving authority or superseding later-issued originals. Cancellation original retry and held late cancellation remain the next slice.

Only these25 GPU processes were rerun: three scoped cancellation cases, old held-original/copy same arrival, old held-standing-recall retry, wing reply recovery, group/historical entry, legacy military/combat, ground material and three smokes. Other GPU scenarios were not rerun.
80m perception,120m local exercise range and600second default receipt deadline remain trial coefficients, not nationwide acceptance.

12second fixed60fps recording contains180 actual Godot frames of original movement and the future cancellation effect plus chronological saved-state cuts; this is not a real-time performance benchmark.

visual_review.method: Direct view_image inspection of five current full-size actual Godot screenshots and five decoded 2/4/6/9/11-second video frames; no mouse automation.
observations: 1280x900 actual terrain and cancellation controls are visible. Same-tick cancellation reply confirms suppression while actual late original/copy acknowledge cancellation.
At actual future stop, UI still says cancellation reply unreceived; after its physical notice arrives it confirms only target-original movement stopped.

When future effect notice misses the moving person, the visible known result remains receipt/waiting; actual paper recovery later shows suppression. This was inspected in saved-state images, not inferred solely from model equality.

Decoded video shows original handoff, pending cancellation, live movement, known scoped stop and rotated final view. It contains chronological saved-state cuts plus180 actual Godot frames; it is not a performance benchmark.
